papers.title: Latent-MOPD: Latent Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Combines routed specialist hidden-state alignment with token-level OPD, using domain-pure updates, a shared width projection, and per-teacher crossfade schedules.

evidence.classification_note: Section 3 and Section 4.1 use student-generated responses, three frozen math/code/logic specialists, a top-16 fixed-advantage token objective, and hidden-state alignment in both same-lineage and differing-width settings.

papers.title: Slow-Fast Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Preservation
papers.summary: Uses an EMA student as a moving reference to remove opposing components of specialist log-probability targets while preserving direct multi-teacher supervision.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 2.1–2.4 and 3.1 use current-student responses, four visual-domain expert models, and projected plus original Jensen–Shannon distillation losses; the EMA reference is additional to the independent teachers.

papers.title: From Gradients to Capabilities: Understanding Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Analyzes how loss averaging, Adam momentum, numerical precision, and vocabulary-restricted distillation translate multi-teacher signals into parameter changes and capability gains.

evidence.classification_note: Section 2 uses fresh student responses with four domain-specific RL teachers and compares full reverse KL, sampled-token policy gradients, and top-k intersection KL during direct MOPD training.

papers.title: Understanding Off- vs On-Policy Distillation: A Tale of Distinct Training Objectives
papers.summary: Analyzes arithmetic versus geometric multi-teacher aggregation targets and conditions under which reverse-KL feedback preserves expert preferences or suppresses correct responses.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3 and 5 study multiple fixed teacher policies, current-student rollouts, and direct reverse-KL optimization; the same analysis compares an offline forward-KL protocol. These are theoretical guarantees under stated assumptions, not a new empirical MOPD recipe.

papers.title: Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.summary: Combines a medical generalist and modality specialists through translator heads, modality-aligned data streams, and feature-dispersion-normalized angular distillation.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3.2–3.5 use a fixed medical image corpus and frozen generalist/specialist teachers; teacher-specific projectors align feature spaces and angular matching directly trains the student. Dispersion normalization is estimated offline, not dynamically learned weighting.

papers.title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
papers.summary: Reuses saved RL and MOPD trajectories with verifier filtering and reviewer-selected token masks, then applies offline supervised relearning while retaining full trajectory context.

evidence.classification_note: Section 3, Eq. (4), and Section 4.1 use historical self-rollouts and masked cross-entropy; one LLM reviewer selects spans without replacing targets. The relearning stage neither samples current-policy states nor queries an independent teacher pool, despite following MOPD in one experiment.

papers.title: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Keeps domain-label teacher routing while rescaling sampled-token distillation advantages by clipped pooled-to-domain feedback dispersion ratios.

evidence.classification_note: Section 2 and Algorithm 1 use fresh student answers, three separately RL-trained math/code/instruction-following specialists, and domain-normalized advantages in the clipped OPD objective.

papers.title: No Pain, More Gain: Iterative Merging for Effective Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Interleaves domain-routed on-policy distillation with validation-triggered teacher task-vector additions for capabilities that remain under-recovered.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 2 and 3.2 alternate reverse-KL distillation on fresh student responses with selective parameter corrections from five independently specialized teachers; merging supplements a direct MOPD stage.

papers.title: PMOPD: Task Ordering, Cycling, and Parameter-Update Subspace Protection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Protects task-specific update subspaces by projecting gradients and optimizer updates during ordered, repeated blocks of multi-teacher reverse-KL distillation.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3.1 and 4.1–4.2 train a shared student on its own responses under task-specific teachers, with direct reverse-KL supervision and protected task-update subspaces.

papers.title: MAS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-agent Systems
papers.summary: Trains interacting student agents with role-contrastive token advantages and teacher-only conflict attribution from one frozen teacher, making it a multi-agent rather than multi-teacher method.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 2.1 and 3.1-3.4 define joint current-agent rollouts and the direct token-level loss (Eq. 13); role contrast changes only the context of the same teacher. Section 4.1 and Appendix D.5 identify one frozen Qwen3-14B teacher, so independently trained student agents are not independent supervisors.

papers.title: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: Balances imitation of fixed multi-teacher demonstrations with preservation of the base model through token-wise soft targets and domain-specific gradient budgets.

evidence.classification_note: Section 3 constructs targets on teacher-forced prefixes from offline demonstrations and the frozen base distribution; Appendix C identifies independent teachers including DeepSeek-R1, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.5, and Qwen models. There are no student rollouts or required teacher logits.

papers.title: MOPD-Router: Rethinking Teacher Routing in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Routes sampled-token OPD advantages over the full teacher pool using token-level metrics, including ExpertAlign’s comparison of specialization and teaching directions.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3.1–3.3 evaluate independent expert teachers on rollout-student prefixes and combine their sampled-token log-ratio advantages in a clipped student policy objective.

papers.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
papers.summary: Compares domain-routed mixed-KL distillation, offline replay, and model merging for consolidating sequentially acquired reasoning and agent capabilities.

evidence.classification_note: Section 4.1, Eq. (3), and Appendix C route current-student trajectories to frozen stage-specific teachers with direct mixed-KL supervision; the proposed mixture of LoRA experts is a separate alternative, not itself MOPD. The arXiv record says Continue; the manuscript says Continual.

papers.title: Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Calibrates each specialist’s displacement from a shared pre-RL reference to weight teacher-specific reverse-KL losses at every student-generated prefix without domain labels.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 2 and 3.1–3.3 define fresh student-generated prefixes, separately RL-trained math/code/instruction-following teachers, and token-wise weighted teacher-specific reverse-KL losses.

papers.title: One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents
papers.summary: Develops three software-engineering category experts with refresh-repair-expand training, then consolidates them through label-routed MOPD with positive teacher-reference gap extrapolation.

evidence.classification_note: Section 4.4 trains distinct same-origin experts on three category pools; Section 4.5 generates complete current-student trajectories and routes their prefixes to those experts. Equations 24-27 define the sampled-token distillation loss and ReLU-gated extrapolation; environment returns do not enter this integration loss. Earlier expert self-replay is a separate stage.

papers.title: A Statistical Perspective on Knowledge Distillation: Foundations, Classical Methods, and Large Language Model Extensions
papers.summary: Reviews distillation through Bayesian inference, teacher uncertainty, multi-teacher aggregation, sequential transfer, and extensions to language models.

evidence.classification_note: Survey record; method-level MOPD tests are not applicable. Section 4.1 covers multi-teacher aggregation. The date is the journal’s first online publication, preceding the September 27 arXiv submission.

papers.title: Who Teaches Which Token? Verifier-Gated Multi-Expert On-Policy Distillation for Scientific Reasoning
papers.summary: Uses criterion-level verification to license capability experts, localizes their supervision to disagreement tokens, and adds gated distillation advantages to scientific-reasoning GRPO.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3.1–3.4 and 4.1 use current-student rollouts, four separately GRPO-trained capability adapters, and a verifier-gated reverse-KL-derived advantage added directly to the student objective.

papers.title: Decision Shifts, Lost Label Functionality, and an Inconclusive Grounding Audit in Correctness-Gated Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.summary: Analyzes correctness-based filtering and weighting of fixed teacher responses, showing that aggregate decision gains can coexist with lost label recall and inconclusive grounding evidence.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3.3–4.3 distill archived responses from Command-R7B, Qwen3.5, and Granite4.1 into language-model and soft-decision objectives. All arms use fixed evidence and a preserved teacher-response pool; no student-generated training states are used.

papers.title: Video-MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Video Understanding
papers.summary: Routes student-generated video and image responses to three specialist teachers, selecting distillation examples using teacher reliability and the initial teacher-student performance gap.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3.1-3.3 construct separate general-video, temporal-grounding, and STEM experts; Eq. 3 samples the current student and Eq. 4 matches routed teacher distributions with reverse KL. RAIS probes the initial student to select prompts, but distillation responses are generated on-policy rather than reused from those probes.

papers.title: RISE: Recursive Improvement via Self-Extrapolating Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Builds a synthetic teacher by extrapolating between the current policy and a trailing checkpoint, then alternates dense on-policy self-distillation with outcome-grounded RLVR.

evidence.classification_note: Current-student rollouts receive a direct target extrapolated from two checkpoints in the same policy lineage; there is no independent external teacher pool.

papers.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
papers.summary: Shows that semantically diverse few-query sets induce broad state coverage in OPD and that sixteen queries per domain can match full-data three-teacher MOPD.

evidence.classification_note: The multi-teacher study trains one current student with separate math, code, and instruction-following teachers routed by domain and a direct sampled-token OPD objective.

papers.title: Learn from Whoever Is Right: Answer-Verified Multi-Teacher Distillation for Multi-Domain LLMs
papers.summary: Selects every frozen domain teacher whose private answer passes a verifier, then consolidates verified feedback and student self-anchors through a privileged EMA teacher.

evidence.classification_note: Current-student rollout groups are reviewed by independently queried frozen science-domain teachers; verified feedback is consolidated through a privileged EMA teacher and transferred with token-level JSD.

papers.title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Audits each routed domain teacher with verifier-scored probes, admits dense sampled-token OPD only when prompt-level reliability passes, and otherwise uses GRPO.

evidence.classification_note: The multi-domain experiment uses separate math, code, and instruction-following teachers on current-student rollouts; accepted teachers provide reverse-KL supervision and failed audits fall back to verifier-grounded GRPO.

papers.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction
papers.summary: Uses teacher confidence to replace unreliable student tokens, applies cross-entropy at corrected positions and forward KL at retained positions, and progressively relaxes intervention.

evidence.classification_note: Separate GUI-grounding and OCR teachers supervise one routed student; every token begins as a student proposal, but teacher corrections enter later prefixes, making state provenance mixed while CE and KL remain direct.

papers.title: LoFi RADIO: A Distilled In-Domain Backbone Applied for Artifact-Severity Grading of Ultra-Low-Field Neonatal Brain MR
papers.summary: Distills DINOv2, BiomedCLIP, and Phikon features on unlabeled low-field MRI into one compact in-domain ViT-S backbone for neonatal artifact grading.

evidence.classification_note: Three frozen heterogeneous vision foundation models provide summary-token and dense-feature targets on a fixed low-field MRI corpus to one ViT-S student.

papers.title: MERGED: Multimodal Entity Resolution via Generated Expert Reasoning Distillation
papers.summary: Uses two teacher VLMs to generate product-pair labels and rationales, training on agreements by SFT and turning meta-judged disagreements into DPO preferences.

evidence.classification_note: Two distinct teacher VLMs generate fixed labels and rationales; consensus examples train the student with SFT and meta-judged disagreements train it with DPO.

papers.title: Instella-MoE Technical Report
papers.summary: Routes instruction-following rollouts to an IF-RL expert and other rollouts to the frozen DPO anchor, using sampled-token reverse KL to integrate the new capability while preserving broad performance.

evidence.classification_note: The MOPD stage scores current-student rollouts with two independently served frozen checkpoints, an IF-RL specialist and the DPO anchor, then updates the student from their sampled-token log-probability gaps.

papers.title: CRAD: Class-wise Reliability-Aware Distillation for Decentralized Heterogeneous Federated Learning
papers.summary: Filters peer teachers by class-wise consensus and weights the survivors by local reliability, enabling decentralized distillation across heterogeneous federated clients.

evidence.classification_note: Each client distills several heterogeneous peer snapshots on its fixed local data; because every client remains a changing teacher and learner rather than one final student, the method is cataloged as online-peer adjacent work.

papers.title: WDL-OPD: Weak-Driven On-Policy Distillation via Mixture-Constrained Co-Training
papers.summary: Co-trains an anchor and auxiliary policy by matching their geometric token-distribution mixture to one frozen teacher on anchor-generated states, allowing either learned branch to be deployed.

evidence.classification_note: The anchor supplies current-student states and reverse KL trains both branches, but only one frozen external teacher exists and the auxiliary is a co-trained learner.

papers.title: MAGA: Multi-Platform Self-Fusion of GUI Agents via Structured Action Distillation
papers.summary: Weights routed GUI distillation by action correctness, suppresses invalid parameter targets, and gives each frozen domain teacher an action-type hint while scoring student-generated tokens.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3.1-3.4 and Eq. 4 distill separate frozen mobile, desktop, and web teachers through weighted sampled-token advantages. On-policy status applies to the student's one-step response prefixes conditioned on offline GUI inputs; training does not claim fresh multi-step environment trajectories. Only the teacher receives the reference action-type hint.

papers.title: One Student, Many Teachers: Multi-Task On-Policy Distillation via Soft-Prompt Privileged Context
papers.summary: Builds lightweight task-specific soft-prompt teachers on one frozen backbone, then routes current-student rollouts among them for parallel reverse-KL capability integration.

evidence.classification_note: Four independently trained and frozen soft prompts define task-specific teacher policies; each current-student rollout is routed to one and receives token-level reverse-KL supervision.

papers.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL Technical Report
papers.summary: Consolidates text-to-image and image-editing RL teachers by matching their guided velocity fields along the student diffusion trajectories.

evidence.classification_note: Section 4.3 and Eq. (14) save trajectories generated by the current student ODE solver, select one of two task-specialized RL teachers by task, and directly minimize velocity-matching error; classifier-free guidance is supplied by the teacher.

papers.title: NebulaExp-8B: An Empirical Post-Training Pipeline via Full-Scale Ablation Research
papers.summary: Studies domain-routed distillation from four 8B teacher checkpoints with student-sampled responses, alongside controlled SFT and reinforcement-learning ablations.

evidence.classification_note: Section V-C1, Eqs. (1)–(2), and V-C2 use current-student rollouts and direct reverse-KL supervision. The final pool is Math-epoch3, Science-epoch3, IF-epoch3 for code, and IF-epoch4 for instruction following; these are distinct frozen checkpoints, not four independently trained final policies.

papers.title: Skill-Conditioned Gated Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
papers.summary: Instantiates several skill-conditioned views of a live self-teacher, validates each view against verifier outcomes, and weights a bounded polarity-aware sampled-token loss.

evidence.classification_note: All named teachers are stop-gradient privileged views of the same synchronized policy under different skill contexts, not independent teacher checkpoints.

papers.title: Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation via Teacher-Informed Mixture Priors
papers.summary: Forms a teacher-informed mixture prior with sample-wise entropy weights and samples the student posterior to combine teacher expertise with uncertainty estimates.

evidence.classification_note: Sections 3–5 construct a mixture prior from several pretrained teachers’ class probabilities on fixed training inputs, then directly update student parameters through posterior gradients; Section 8 includes protein and image-classification tasks.

papers.title: When the Strongest Teacher Is Not the Best Teacher: Student-Centric Answer Selection
papers.summary: Ranks verified answers from a heterogeneous thirty-model teacher pool by a forward-only student learning-cost proxy and resamples low-cost supervision as the student evolves.

evidence.classification_note: Verified responses from thirty independent teacher models form a fixed candidate pool; the current student only scores and selects answers before offline supervised updates.

papers.title: On-Policy Distillation with Best-of-N Teacher Rollout Selection
papers.summary: Selects the most correct and student-aligned trajectory from several samples of one teacher, then adds teacher-context supervision to standard student-context OPD.

evidence.classification_note: The main OPD branch uses current-student states, while the auxiliary branch uses a selected teacher trajectory; the rollout pool contains several samples from one teacher, not independent teachers.

papers.title: Multi-Teacher Ensemble Distillation: A Mathematical Framework for Probability-Domain Knowledge Aggregation
papers.summary: Provides an axiomatic operator framework and variance, bias, log-loss, and safety guarantees for probability-domain aggregation across heterogeneous teachers.

evidence.classification_note: The analysis formalizes probability aggregation from multiple teachers into a student target on conventional static inputs; it does not use student-generated states.

papers.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms
papers.summary: Controlled comparison of parameter merging, mixed-domain RL, and MOPD using shared experts and data; identifies when each fusion paradigm is preferable.

evidence.classification_note: The controlled MOPD arm routes current-student rollouts to domain RLVR teachers; the paper's main contribution is comparative analysis of fusion paradigms.

papers.title: Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD
papers.summary: Uses dual-temperature sampling, positive-advantage-density filtering, and entropy-calibrated token filtering to preserve general capabilities during specialization.

evidence.classification_note: Domain and general teachers supervise student samples through uncertainty-calibrated trajectory and token filtering.

papers.title: D$^3$-MOPD: Adaptive Dynamic Domain ScheDuling for Efficient Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.summary: Adapts domain sampling ratios from the already-computed reverse-KL trajectories to reduce wasted rollout steps across differently converging domains.

evidence.classification_note: Four domain teachers provide routed reverse-KL supervision while an adaptive scheduler reallocates rollout and update budget.

papers.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: An end-to-end open recipe that diagnoses token-budget imbalance and introduces token-share balancing, gap-aware allocation, and student-reward refresh.

evidence.classification_note: Math, code, and instruction teachers supervise current SmolLM3 tokens; token-share and gap-aware allocation address capability imbalance.

papers.title: Every Coin Has Two Sides: On the Dual Nature of Generalization in On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Studies OPD generalization across distribution, language, horizon, domain, and multi-teacher settings, revealing origin dependence and mixture-driven capability seesaws.

evidence.classification_note: A qualifying two-teacher routed MOPD setup is used chiefly to analyze transfer and mixture-induced capability seesaws.

papers.title: Poly-OPD: Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability-Selectable Flow Models
papers.summary: Bridges incompatible latent spaces through pixels and combines heterogeneous flow-model teachers with compatibility-aware adapters and gap-aware scheduling.

evidence.classification_note: Incompatible flow teachers are bridged through pixels and matched on student-induced states with compatibility-aware adapters.

papers.title: Language-Specialized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
papers.summary: Routes multilingual student rollouts to ranked language-specialized RL teachers and studies static versus dynamic acoustic-prefix consistency.

evidence.classification_note: Multilingual student rollouts are sent to ranked language-specialized teachers and optimized with reliability-weighted top-K reverse KL.

papers.title: SMOPD: Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning via Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Trains reward-specialized teachers first, then merges their capabilities with online policy distillation to balance sparse and dense objectives.

evidence.classification_note: Reward-specialized policies are combined during online student sampling with a top-K mixture FKL objective plus a GDPO anchor.

papers.title: Beyond the Best Teacher: Expanding and Compressing the Reasoning Solution Manifold
papers.summary: Constructs complementary RL teachers with residual GRPO and compresses their reliable union through quality-gated Teacher-Union OPD.

evidence.classification_note: Complementary residual-GRPO teachers are compressed through reliability gating and a consensus-plus-residual teacher-union objective.

papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
papers.summary: A controlled study of planning acquisition, OPD shaping, and MOPD integration under shared, partially shared, and conflicting planning patterns.

evidence.classification_note: Single- then multi-teacher agentic OPD on student trajectories is used to study shared, partially shared, and conflicting planning patterns.

papers.title: When Top-K Misses the Decision: Tool-Call Drift in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Shows that high retained top-k teacher mass can omit decision-critical coordinates and causally links support restoration to tool-call behavior.

evidence.classification_note: The two-teacher support-restoration study uses 80% current-student continuation and 20% dataset continuation with an SFT anchor.

papers.title: UI-MOPD: Multi-Platform On-Policy Distillation for Unified GUI Agents
papers.summary: Dynamically routes each student rollout to its desktop- or mobile-specialized teacher to integrate platform expertise without behavior averaging.

evidence.classification_note: Every student GUI rollout is routed by platform to a desktop or mobile teacher and trained with action-policy reverse KL.

papers.title: H-OPD: Confidence Aware Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher Multimodal On-policy Distillation
papers.summary: Replaces static sample-level routing with token-level confidence arbitration between vision-language and text-only teachers.

evidence.classification_note: A vision-language and a text-only teacher are arbitrated tokenwise by confidence over merged top-K support on student responses.

papers.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
papers.summary: Introduces domain-routed MOPD with salient-vocabulary alignment to consolidate six heterogeneous agent domains into Agents-A1.

evidence.classification_note: Six agent-domain teachers provide domain-routed salient-vocabulary reverse-KL supervision on Agents-A1 rollouts.

papers.title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
papers.summary: Canonical general formulation: train domain RL teachers independently, then distill each teacher on student-generated trajectories with dense supervision.

evidence.classification_note: The canonical formulation routes each current-student trajectory to its independently RL-trained domain teacher for reverse-KL supervision.

papers.title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
papers.summary: Routes student-induced flow states to capability fields and distills text-to-image and editing experts with a velocity objective.

evidence.classification_note: Text-to-image and editing fields are routed on states induced by the current student flow and matched through a velocity objective.

papers.title: Counteraction-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for General Capability Recovery with Domain Preservation
papers.summary: Addresses recovery-preservation gradient counteraction with alternating updates and gap-based selection under incomplete prompt coverage.

evidence.classification_note: Domain and general teachers directly supervise student rollouts while alternating updates prevent recovery and preservation gradients from canceling.

papers.title: CollectionLoRA: Collecting 50 Effects in 1 LoRA via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Consolidates dozens of effect LoRAs and few-step generation into one LoRA using dual-stream routing, prompt isolation, and coarse-to-fine distillation.

evidence.classification_note: Dozens of effect LoRA teachers are consolidated on student-induced generative states through dual-stream routing and coarse-to-fine scheduling.

papers.title: ProteinOPD: Towards Effective and Efficient Preference Alignment for Protein Design
papers.summary: Distills preference-specific protein teachers into the geometric consensus of a shared student while bounding conflict and retaining designability.

evidence.classification_note: Preference-specific protein teachers form an adaptively weighted geometric consensus that directly supervises the shared student policy.

papers.title: Uni-OPD: Unifying On-Policy Distillation with a Dual-Perspective Recipe
papers.summary: Balances informative student exploration and outcome-consistent teacher reliability across single- and multi-teacher LLM/MLLM settings.

evidence.classification_note: The qualifying multi-teacher setting routes student responses by task and calibrates teacher reliability with outcome consistency and margins.

papers.title: MAD-OPD: Breaking the Ceiling in On-Policy Distillation via Multi-Agent Debate
papers.summary: Turns the teacher into a confidence-weighted debating collective and adds step-level OPAD for long agent trajectories.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple teachers debate and are confidence-weighted before JSD, reverse-KL, or step-level OPAD supervision is applied to student trajectories.

papers.title: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
papers.summary: Swift-Image applies parallel expert RL followed by MOPD to unify text-to-image, single-image editing, and multi-image editing.

evidence.classification_note: Swift-Image uses a material on-policy generative-field distillation stage after parallel RL of three image-generation and editing experts.

papers.title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models
papers.summary: Unifies finance reasoning and agent-execution experts through model merging plus MOPD in compact finance-native agents.

evidence.classification_note: Finance reasoning and agent-execution experts are first parameter-merged and then consolidated through a task-routed on-policy distillation stage.

papers.title: From Passive Delegates to Strategic Negotiators: Reinforcing Social Reasoning in Small Language Models with SocialRL
papers.summary: Uses MOPD as one consolidation strategy for six domain-specialized social-reasoning policies in a unified 4B model.

evidence.classification_note: Six social and negotiation policies provide domain-conditioned OPD targets for a unified 4B model.

papers.title: Motif 3: Technical Report
papers.summary: Consolidates six RL specialists and one supervised software-engineering teacher with MOPD in a 314B MoE model.

evidence.classification_note: Six RL specialists and one supervised software-engineering teacher are hard-routed for dense token-level alignment on current-model rollouts.

papers.title: Capek 0.5: An Execution-Centric Vision-Language Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary: Combines four embodied capability specialists using parameter merging followed by routed policy-space MOPD.

evidence.classification_note: Four embodied specialists are parameter-merged before a routed policy-space MOPD stage on student trajectories.

papers.title: Cross-Domain Hybrid OPD for Generalizable Search Agents
papers.summary: Combines search-agent RL with cross-domain expert OPD to recover general capabilities without surrendering search specialization.

evidence.classification_note: General-domain student prompts receive routed expert reverse-KL supervision while search prompts remain on a GRPO branch.

papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
papers.summary: Uses nine domain-by-reasoning-effort expert policies and a clipped sampled-token OPD reward for final consolidation.

evidence.classification_note: Nine domain-by-reasoning-effort expert policies supply clipped sampled-token OPD rewards to the final student.

papers.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report
papers.summary: Trains twelve domain specialists and consolidates them with MOPD into a 250B-A15B long-context agentic model.

evidence.classification_note: Twelve independently trained domain specialists are routed to provide dense token-level OPD targets for Solar Open 2.

papers.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
papers.summary: Fuses reasoning, general, and agent RL experts using dynamically scheduled routed reverse-KL MOPD.

evidence.classification_note: Reasoning, general, and agent teachers are routed under a dynamically adjusted three-track reverse-KL MOPD schedule.

papers.title: KAT-Coder-V2.5 Technical Report
papers.summary: Unifies SWE, Agent-Claw, and WebCoding experts through MOPD in an executable-repository coding agent.

evidence.classification_note: SWE, Agent-Claw, and WebCoding teachers are selected by task for token-level OPD on executable student trajectories.

papers.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
papers.summary: Scales full-vocabulary multi-teacher OPD across independently trained domain experts as a principal capability-consolidation stage.

evidence.classification_note: Context relevance selects or weights independently trained domain experts for full-vocabulary reverse KL on current-policy trajectories.

papers.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
papers.summary: Uses more than ten domain-specialized teachers and dense token-level MOPD during post-training of a 550B-A55B hybrid model.

evidence.classification_note: More than ten domain-specialized teachers provide dense token-level MOPD during post-training of Nemotron 3 Ultra.

papers.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
papers.summary: Pairs cross-modal MOPD with context and video RL to integrate code, tool, search, and long-video capabilities.

evidence.classification_note: Cross-modal code, tool, search, and long-video experts directly supervise student states, alongside separate context and video RL objectives.

papers.title: OneReason Technical Report
papers.summary: Uses a specialize-then-unify RL recipe with MOPD to integrate four recommendation domains into one reasoning model.

evidence.classification_note: Four recommendation-domain RL specialists are selected by domain to train one unified reasoning model with OPD.

papers.title: KAT-Coder-V2 Technical Report
papers.summary: A specialize-then-unify coding-agent pipeline that consolidates five domain experts with OPD on student trajectories.

evidence.classification_note: Five coding and agent experts are task-routed for OPD on student-generated repository trajectories.

papers.title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Interleaves Cascade RL with multi-domain OPD from the strongest intermediate checkpoint for each domain.

evidence.classification_note: Cascade RL is interleaved with OPD from the strongest retained checkpoint per domain, using sampled teacher-student log-probability advantage.

papers.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
papers.summary: Uses checkpoints from preceding SFT and RL stages as teachers in final on-policy cross-stage distillation to recover capabilities.

evidence.classification_note: Earlier SFT and domain-RL checkpoints become task-routed teachers for final on-policy cross-stage KL distillation.

papers.title: Baichuan-M3: Modeling Clinical Inquiry for Reliable Medical Decision-Making
papers.summary: Combines task RL, offline forward-KL policy distillation, and final reverse-KL MOPD under task rewards and multiple teacher priors.

evidence.classification_note: The medical recipe combines fixed-data clipped forward KL with a later mixed-domain on-policy reverse-KL stage under teacher priors and task rewards.

papers.title: ORBIT: On-policy Exploration-Exploitation for Controllable Multi-Budget Reasoning
papers.summary: Fuses reasoning policies specialized for different compute budgets through on-policy distillation into a controllable unified model.

evidence.classification_note: Policies specialized for different reasoning budgets are selected by requested budget and distilled on-policy into one controllable model.

papers.title: MiMo-V2-Flash Technical Report
papers.summary: An early frontier-model report to explicitly formulate MOPD: domain RL teachers provide dense token-level rewards on student rollouts.

evidence.classification_note: The student samples responses and the matching domain RL teacher supplies token-level log-probability rewards alongside outcome-model reward.

papers.title: REGEN: Replay-recycling for Expert-to-Generalist distillation with Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: An explicit offline alternative to MOPD that recycles specialist RL replay memory and matches MOPD at lower coupled rollout-training cost.

evidence.classification_note: REGEN recycles specialist replay memories through offline RL, making it an explicit lower-coupling alternative rather than on-policy MOPD.

papers.title: DOPD: Dual On-policy Distillation
papers.summary: Routes token supervision between privileged teacher and privileged student policies; dual-source rather than a standard pool of independent teachers.

evidence.classification_note: DOPD routes token supervision between one privileged external teacher and a privileged student view, not a pool of independent teachers.

papers.title: Be My Tutor: On-Policy Co-Distillation for Mutual LLM Improvement via Peer Feedback
papers.summary: Two domain-specialized peers tutor each other through feedback-conditioned self-distillation loops to achieve mutual Pareto improvement.

evidence.classification_note: Two trainable domain peers tutor each other bidirectionally; each learner lacks a fixed multi-teacher-to-one-student supervisor pool.

papers.title: Multi-Rollout On-Policy Distillation via Peer Successes and Failures
papers.summary: Constructs peer-conditioned teacher signals from successful and failed sibling rollouts; multiple rollouts, not multiple independent teachers.

evidence.classification_note: The supervision contrasts successful and failed sibling rollouts from one policy; multi denotes rollouts rather than independent teachers.

papers.title: CoDistill-GRPO: A Co-Distillation Recipe for Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization
papers.summary: Bidirectionally co-distills two trainable policies inside GRPO rather than consolidating a frozen multi-teacher pool.

evidence.classification_note: Two trainable policies co-distill bidirectionally inside GRPO instead of consolidating several independent teachers into one student.

papers.title: UniSD: Towards a Unified Self-Distillation Framework for Large Language Models
papers.summary: Combines EMA teachers, multi-teacher agreement, contrastive alignment, and clipping in a self-distillation framework.

evidence.classification_note: EMA/self teachers and agreement views come from one student lineage, so the framework is self-distillation rather than independent multi-teacher OPD.

papers.title: Merge-of-Thought Distillation
papers.summary: Alternates teacher-specific supervised distillation branches with weight averaging to consolidate complementary long-chain reasoning from multiple teachers.

evidence.classification_note: Version 3, Section 4, trains branches by token-level cross-entropy on fixed teacher-generated rationale corpora before each weight merge. This includes substantive distillation rather than pure parameter merging, but does not train on student rollouts.

papers.title: Learning from Multiple Teacher Networks
papers.summary: Seminal explicit multi-teacher KD method that averages dark knowledge and transfers intermediate inter-example relations.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple teacher networks supervise a student on fixed examples through averaged soft targets and inter-example relations.

papers.title: Model Compression with Two-stage Multi-teacher Knowledge Distillation for Web Question Answering System
papers.summary: Pretrains a compact model on a general QA distillation task and then fine-tunes it from multiple downstream task teachers.

evidence.classification_note: A fixed-data two-stage recipe transfers general QA knowledge and then multiple downstream teacher targets into one student.

papers.title: Agree to Disagree: Adaptive Ensemble Knowledge Distillation in Gradient Space
papers.summary: Treats teachers as multiple gradient objectives and finds a Pareto-compatible student update instead of naively averaging conflicting teachers.

evidence.classification_note: Independent teacher losses directly determine a Pareto-compatible student update on fixed training data.

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Teacher Multi-Level Knowledge Distillation
papers.summary: Learns instance-specific teacher weights for soft targets and combines multi-level intermediate hints from different teachers.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple teachers provide instance-weighted output targets and intermediate hints over a static corpus.

papers.title: One Teacher is Enough? Pre-trained Language Model Distillation from Multiple Teachers
papers.summary: MT-BERT co-finetunes multiple PLM teachers and distills both their aligned hidden states and soft labels into one student.

evidence.classification_note: BERT, RoBERTa, and UniLM teachers are aligned through co-finetuning before their hidden states and labels supervise one student.

papers.title: Multiple Teacher Distillation for Robust and Greener Models
papers.summary: Studies multiple-teacher compression as a path to more robust NLP models with lower inference cost.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple independently trained teacher runs supervise compact NLP students on fixed task data.

papers.title: PILE: Pairwise Iterative Logits Ensemble for Multi-Teacher Labeled Distillation
papers.summary: Iteratively ensembles teacher logits under label supervision for compressed ranking models deployed in commercial search.

evidence.classification_note: Several teacher logits are combined by a label-guided pairwise iterative ensemble before supervising the ranking student.

papers.title: Collaborative Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation for Learning Low Bit-Width Deep Neural Networks
papers.summary: Jointly trains quantized teachers and student while forming importance-aware shared intermediate knowledge.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple quantized teacher branches directly supervise the student, but the teachers and student are collaboratively optimized rather than a fixed independent pool.

papers.title: Multi-teacher Distillation for Multilingual Spelling Correction
papers.summary: Distills one monolingual teacher per locale into a latency-constrained multilingual spelling-correction student.

evidence.classification_note: Locale-specialized monolingual teachers provide fixed-data targets for one multilingual spelling-correction student.

papers.title: Knowledge Fusion of Large Language Models
papers.summary: FuseLLM aligns and fuses the token distributions of heterogeneous source LLMs into one target model through continual training.

evidence.classification_note: Heterogeneous source LLM distributions are aligned and fused into a target model through offline continual training.

papers.title: GOVERN: Gradient Orientation Vote Ensemble for Multi-Teacher Reinforced Distillation
papers.summary: Uses gradient-orientation voting to combine multiple teachers during unsupervised distillation without label guidance.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple teacher objectives vote through gradient orientation and directly determine the label-free student update.

papers.title: FuseChat: Knowledge Fusion of Chat Models
papers.summary: Transfers heterogeneous chat models into common target models through token alignment, then merges those targets in parameter space.

evidence.classification_note: Heterogeneous chat-model token spaces are aligned for pairwise distillation before the resulting target models are merged.

papers.title: Class Incremental Learning with Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.summary: Constructs diverse lightweight teacher branches to improve compatibility between retained and newly learned classes.

evidence.classification_note: Several lightweight teacher branches directly supervise class-incremental learning, but they are synthesized through related-weight and feature perturbations rather than independently trained sources.

papers.title: MCAD: Multi-teacher Cross-modal Alignment Distillation for Efficient Image-Text Retrieval
papers.summary: Combines single-stream and dual-stream teacher advantages to train an efficient dual-stream image-text retrieval student.

evidence.classification_note: Single-stream and dual-stream retrieval teachers provide complementary distribution and feature targets on fixed image-text data.

papers.title: Exploring Knowledge Purification in Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation for LLMs
papers.summary: Purifies conflicting rationales from multiple teacher LLMs into a single training rationale and compares several routing strategies.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple teacher rationales are consolidated or selected into static purified supervision before student training.

papers.title: Find Your Optimal Teacher: Personalized Data Synthesis via Router-Guided Multi-Teacher Distillation
papers.summary: Routes each prompt to the teacher that jointly maximizes response quality and student learnability for personalized synthetic data.

evidence.classification_note: A router chooses one of several teachers per prompt, and the selected teacher response becomes fixed synthetic student supervision.

papers.title: HistoMILKD: A Multiple Instance Learning based Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation Framework for Whole Slide Image Classification
papers.summary: Distills complementary pathology foundation models into a single multiple-instance-learning adapter for whole-slide classification.

evidence.classification_note: Complementary pathology foundation models provide representation targets to one whole-slide multiple-instance student adapter.

papers.title: Model Compression
papers.summary: Compresses a cumbersome ensemble into a compact neural network using ensemble soft predictions and synthetic unlabeled examples.

evidence.classification_note: A cumbersome ensemble produces soft predictions on fixed or synthetic unlabeled examples for one compact model.

papers.title: Do Deep Nets Really Need to be Deep?
papers.summary: Shows that shallow networks can mimic deep models and multi-CNN ensembles, providing an empirical precursor to modern knowledge distillation.

evidence.classification_note: A shallow model mimics predictions from deep models and multi-CNN ensembles on a fixed corpus.

papers.title: Distilling Knowledge from Ensembles of Neural Networks for Speech Recognition
papers.summary: Distills a late-fusion ensemble of recurrent acoustic models with different architectures and objectives into one deployable recognizer.

evidence.classification_note: A late-fusion ensemble of recurrent acoustic teachers with different architectures and objectives defines the student target.

papers.title: Ensemble Distillation for Neural Machine Translation
papers.summary: Transfers an NMT ensemble or oracle-BLEU teacher into one model and uses teacher knowledge to filter the training data.

evidence.classification_note: An NMT ensemble or oracle-selected teacher supplies offline distribution and sequence supervision to a single translation model.

papers.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation from an Ensemble of Teachers
papers.summary: Uses minibatch-level teacher switching and multi-stream teacher-distribution augmentation for efficient acoustic-model distillation.

evidence.classification_note: Several acoustic teachers supervise fixed-data minibatches through teacher switching and distribution augmentation.

papers.title: MEAL: Multi-Model Ensemble via Adversarial Learning
papers.summary: Uses block-wise adversarial discriminators to transfer representations from teachers with diverse architectures into one student.

evidence.classification_note: Block-wise adversarial feature alignment transfers representations from diverse teacher architectures into one student.

papers.title: FEED: Feature-level Ensemble for Knowledge Distillation
papers.summary: Transfers multi-teacher feature maps through parallel or sequential nonlinear transformations without adding inference-time parameters.

evidence.classification_note: Parallel or sequential transformations align several teacher feature spaces with a single student's representation.

papers.title: Unifying Heterogeneous Classifiers With Distillation
papers.summary: Uses generic unlabeled data to unify classifiers with different architectures and class sets into one model over the union label space.

evidence.classification_note: Classifiers with different architectures and label spaces directly supervise a union-label student on generic unlabeled data.

papers.title: Distilled Person Re-Identification: Towards a More Scalable System
papers.summary: Transfers pairwise similarity knowledge from multiple scene teachers and adaptively selects useful teachers without accessing source data.

evidence.classification_note: Scene-specific teachers contribute adaptively selected pairwise-similarity targets without requiring their source data.

papers.title: Customizing Student Networks From Heterogeneous Teachers via Adaptive Knowledge Amalgamation
papers.summary: Adaptively extracts and combines heterogeneous single- or multi-task teacher knowledge into a user-specified multitask student.

evidence.classification_note: Heterogeneous single- and multi-task teachers provide adaptively combined knowledge for a customized multitask student.

papers.title: Confidence-Aware Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation
papers.summary: Uses label-aware sample-wise reliability to suppress poor teacher predictions and combines them with intermediate-feature transfer.

evidence.classification_note: Sample-wise reliability weights suppress poor teacher predictions while output and feature targets train the student.

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation with Meta-Learning
papers.summary: Trains a meta-weight network to tailor output- and feature-level teacher fusion to the student's learning capacity.

evidence.classification_note: A meta-weight network adapts multiple output- and feature-level teacher targets to the student's capacity.

papers.title: Learning Lightweight Object Detectors via Multi-Teacher Progressive Distillation
papers.summary: Uses a sequence of detector teachers to bridge progressively from strong heterogeneous detectors to a lightweight student.

evidence.classification_note: Independent heterogeneous detector teachers supervise the lightweight student progressively over fixed detection data.

papers.title: Reinforced Multi-Teacher Selection for Knowledge Distillation
papers.summary: Uses reinforcement learning to assign teacher weights dynamically for each training instance and the current student capability.

evidence.classification_note: A reinforcement-learned selector assigns instance-specific weights to multiple teacher targets on a fixed NLP dataset.

papers.title: MulDE: Multi-teacher Knowledge Distillation for Low-dimensional Knowledge Graph Embeddings
papers.summary: Lets a compact KGE student query several hyperbolic teachers and combines their scores with relation-specific scaling and contrast attention.

evidence.classification_note: Several hyperbolic KGE teachers provide scores that are combined with relation-specific scaling and contrast attention.

papers.title: Beyond Answers: Transferring Reasoning Capabilities to Smaller LLMs Using Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation
papers.summary: Distills answers and rationales from several teacher LLMs with an in-context generator and teacher-forced chain-of-thought.

evidence.classification_note: Several teacher LLMs generate answers and rationales that become a fixed chain-of-thought training corpus for the student.

papers.title: Learning from Committee: Reasoning Distillation from a Mixture of Teachers with Peer-Review
papers.summary: Has teacher LLMs diagnose student errors and uses simulated peer review to retain high-quality instructional rationales.

evidence.classification_note: A teacher committee diagnoses errors and peer-reviews candidate instructional rationales before they train the student offline.

papers.title: AM-RADIO: Agglomerative Vision Foundation Model — Reduce All Domains Into One
papers.summary: Agglomerates complementary vision foundation-model capabilities into a single efficient general-purpose visual encoder.

evidence.classification_note: Complementary vision foundation models directly provide heterogeneous representation targets to one universal visual encoder.

papers.title: UNIC: Universal Classification Models via Multi-teacher Distillation
papers.summary: Uses expendable ladder projectors and teacher dropping to balance complementary pretrained vision teachers in one universal encoder.

evidence.classification_note: Teacher dropping and ladder projectors balance complementary pretrained vision-teacher features in one encoder.

papers.title: Theia: Distilling Diverse Vision Foundation Models for Robot Learning
papers.summary: Distills diverse off-the-shelf vision foundation models into a compact encoder tailored to downstream robot policy learning.

evidence.classification_note: Diverse pretrained vision foundation models directly supervise a compact encoder later used by robot policies.

papers.title: DUNE: Distilling a Universal Encoder from Heterogeneous 2D and 3D Teachers
papers.summary: Co-distills heterogeneous 2D, 3D, and human-perception teachers into one universal visual encoder.

evidence.classification_note: Heterogeneous 2D, 3D, and human-perception teachers supply fixed-data feature targets to a universal encoder.

papers.title: MoVE-KD: Knowledge Distillation for VLMs with Mixture of Visual Encoders
papers.summary: Distills multiple visual encoders into one VLM encoder using teacher-token attention and a mixture-of-LoRA-experts router.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple visual encoders provide feature targets selected by teacher-token attention and a mixture-of-LoRA-experts router.

papers.title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
papers.summary: Foundational temperature-scaled knowledge-distillation formulation and ensemble-to-student motivation.

evidence.classification_note: A teacher ensemble or cumbersome model supplies temperature-softened targets on non-student-generated training examples.

papers.title: Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Early policy-compression and multi-task policy-distillation work that transfers multiple expert policies into one student.

evidence.classification_note: Multiple expert policies generate trajectories and action-distribution targets that are compressed into one multitask student policy.

papers.title: MiniLLM: Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Develops reverse-KL-based generative LLM distillation with student-sampled behavior and practical stabilization methods.

evidence.classification_note: The student samples behavior for reverse-KL distillation, but supervision comes from one teacher model.

papers.title: On-Policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes
papers.summary: GKD formalizes language-model distillation on student-generated sequences and unifies several divergence objectives.

evidence.classification_note: GKD directly matches one teacher on sequences generated by the current student and therefore supplies the single-teacher OPD foundation.

papers.title: DistiLLM: Towards Streamlined Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.summary: Introduces skew-KL objectives and an efficient online distillation pipeline for large language models.

evidence.classification_note: DistiLLM adaptively mixes fixed samples with reused student-generated outputs under one teacher, so only part of its state distribution is current-student induced.

papers.title: Knowledge Distillation: A Survey
papers.summary: Broad survey of response-, feature-, and relation-based knowledge, training schemes, architectures, and applications.

evidence.classification_note: Survey record; method-level MOPD evidence criteria are not applicable.

papers.title: A Survey on Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Systematic survey of LLM knowledge elicitation and distillation algorithms, including white-box and black-box settings.

evidence.classification_note: LLM distillation survey record; method-level MOPD evidence criteria are not applicable.

papers.title: Knowledge Distillation for Language Models
papers.summary: NAACL tutorial covering intermediate and prediction matching, RL-based KD, multi-teacher distillation, and LLM self-distillation.

evidence.classification_note: Tutorial record; method-level MOPD evidence criteria are not applicable.

papers.title: A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.summary: A comprehensive OPD taxonomy and survey covering objectives, signal sources, stabilization, systems, and applications.

evidence.classification_note: On-policy distillation survey record; method-level MOPD evidence criteria are not applicable.
